marta: Heads-up — incoming customer case (Acme Corp) reporting intermittent 429s + spikes in tail latency since 2026-03-16 morning. They say their call volume is steady. ticket #7892.
alex: Can you paste a sample request-id and any X-RateLimit headers? Also tenant_id?
marta: tenant_id=acme-42. Sample from logs:
```
req_id=01FJ3K8ZQ0 made_at=2026-03-16T08:12:04Z route=/v1/generate model=gpt-large tokens=512 status=429 X-RateLimit-Limit=1200 X-RateLimit-Remaining=0 X-RateLimit-Reset=164
```
samir: Quick idea — did the tenant get routed to a different model variant yesterday? If a fallback to a higher-token model happened that could exhaust quota unexpectedly. Also need to check retries/backoff pattern.
lia: On it — I'll check routing logs and model-variant rollouts for acme-42 between 2026-03-15 22:00 -> 2026-03-16 10:00.
alex: For attribution we should run a small query to group by route/model + tenant, looking for a burst window. Example:
```
SELECT
  tenant_id, route, model, count(*) AS requests, sum(tokens) AS tokens, count_if(status=429) AS throttles
FROM requests.ingest
WHERE tenant_id = 'acme-42' AND ts >= '2026-03-15' AND ts < '2026-03-17'
GROUP BY tenant_id, route, model
ORDER BY throttles DESC, tokens DESC
LIMIT 20;
```
marta: I also captured a client retry snippet from them — they had aggressive 3x immediate retries on 429. Might amplify bursts:
```
for i in range(3):
  r = post(req)
  if r.status == 429: continue
  break
```
samir: That retry pattern + a brief model routing change could explain a tenant-local quota blow. Recommend: (1) add tenant-level 429 rate alert, (2) create a dashboard card showing per-tenant tokens-by-model 5m rolling, (3) add a short-term mitigation: temporary soft-throttle at route level for acme-42 to stop cascading retries.
lia: I'll add alert: query that fires when tenant 429 rate > 1% over 5m and tokens/s spikes > baseline *3. Linking alert to runbook.
alex: I'll take deep-dive on infra side — check if prefix/KV cache was cold for their main route and whether batching config changed. Creating internal infra ticket INF-302 and will attach the query results + trace links.
oncall-bot: @alex assigned INF-302 to alex (priority P2). Relevant oncall: eng-sre.
marta: Thanks — I've replied to customer with our mitigation plan and ETA ~2h. Will update ticket #7892 with INF-302 link and follow up when we confirm root cause. :thumbsup:
